The '''Scarlet Sword''', also known simply as the '''Sword''', was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Livien Magnus]]' [[Commerce District]] from which [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] often bought [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], It was owned by a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Gerro]].<ref name="OaA1" />

The entrance to the Scarlet Sword was marked by a large [[Color/Legends|red]] sign. The cantina was in a state of disrepair, and was known to have disreputable patrons.<ref name="OaA1" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the cantina was the base of the [[Ord Radama Rebel Cell]] on [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. Each night, multiple Rebel agents would enter the bar and pretend to be drunk, while actually gathering information.<ref name="OaA1" />
